I drink Darjeeling and Darjeeling-based blends, mostly. Second flush Darjeeling by preference, but that's one of those things that's really up to personal taste. I'll have Lapsang or Earl Grey if I want something different, or sometimes straight Assam. No sugar in all cases, milk if I'm too impatient to let it cool. Or if it's not terribly good tea.

My top pick is a 5:3:2 blend of Assam, Darjeeling and Ceylon teas. It's one of very few teas I have found that I like just as well cool as hot.

You might like Lapsang Souchong if you liked Russian caravan tea. It's smokier, but Russian caravan tea contains some Lapsang, so you get a broad similarity in flavour.
I am a fan of Pu-erh, so that's what I'm going to recommend here. Depending on the one you will get, it'll be earthy, with a strong taste and smell. There's nothing quite like it.
I like the non-fruit herbal teas, like licorice, chamomile, and peppermint. At the moment I'm enjoying a cinnamon tea, which might be good for a sweet-tea person like you :)
I typically only drink traditional unflavoured teas (no milk, no sugar) so from that selection if you like sweeter teas I suppose a white tea such as bai hao yin zhen is the way to go.
I really like Japanese greens. I haven't had any Gyokuro yet because I'm still fairly new to tea and a college student on a budget, but the low-mid priced Senchas I've had from O-Cha are fantastic.
Harney and Son's Hot Cinnamon Tea is one of my favorites. Its naturally a little sweet, so I don't even add anything to it. Its great if you love spicy tea.

In case you didn't want to make a script for creating images for a screenlapse of you game jamming, here it is

Ctrl + C to stop the script.

#!/bin/bash

# This script requires scrot

# Wait time can be 10s for 10 seconds, or 2m for 2 minutes, or 5h for 5 hours,
# or 2d for 2 days. As long as "sleep" can accept it, it will work

# SCREENLAPSE_PATH can be any path that the current user has directory
# permissions to. If it contains a directory that does not exist, it will
# automatically create it

# Inside the SCREENLAPSE_PATH, this script will create a directory 00000
# and put screenshots in there. If 00000 exists, it will create 00001.
# And so on if 00001 exists.

SCREENLAPSE_WAIT_BETWEEN_SHOTS='30s'
SCREENLAPSE_PATH='/home/stephen/Pictures/screenlapse'




#### DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING UNLESS YOU HAVE MAGIC FINGERS

SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR=0

mkdir -p "$SCREENLAPSE_PATH"
while [ -d "$SCREENLAPSE_PATH/$( printf '%05d' $SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR )" ]; do
 echo "dir $SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR exists"
 SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR=$(( SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR + 1 ))
done

mkdir -p $SCREENLAPSE_PATH/$( printf '%05d' $SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR )
echo "Created dir $SCREENLAPSE_PATH/$( printf '%05d' $SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR )"

SCREENLAPSE_FILENAME=0

while [ 1 ]; do
 echo $SCREENLAPSE_FILENAME
 scrot -z "$SCREENLAPSE_PATH/$( printf '%05d' $SCREENLAPSE_SUBDIR )/$( printf '%05d' $SCREENLAPSE_FILENAME ).png"
 SCREENLAPSE_FILENAME=$(( SCREENLAPSE_FILENAME + 1 ))
 sleep "$SCREENLAPSE_WAIT_BETWEEN_SHOTS"
done

What's the most useful Minecraft invention in your opinion?

Simple, automated chicken farm. It works by having chickens in a torrent of of water and collecting their eggs with a hopper and chests, you can then expand it by using a redstone clock and a dispenser to throw the eggs against the wall to automatically breed new chickens, this gives you not only a fast supply of food but also a cheap xp-farm before you have access to the end. Should you have set up an xp farm in the end, you can tweak it further and turn it into an automated farm for grilled chicken.

An Iron Farm and an Enderman Farm are the must-haves for late game survival. Also I'd recommend a cow farm such as this, it's not fully automatic like a chicken farm, but beef is a better food source and you also get leather.

If you've already got all your survival resources taken care of, slime block launchers are really fun to play around with and allow a lot of creativity in builds.
